messages:
IncidentBot: pager: multiple 504s observed hitting inference-gateway-us-west-2 since 10:12 UTC. alerting on 5xx spike > 3% over 1m.
Alex: on it. I'm looking at the gateway fleet + upstream model pods. assigning to me for now.
Jamie: tagging for customer-impact assessment — which tenants saw errors?
Alex: quick check: error-rate spike concentrated on rtx-pool nodes 3-7, traffic shows increased tail latencies for seq>2048. Not a quota issue.
Priya: pulling per-tenant request logs now. preliminary: ~18 customers with >1% failed requests; 3 enterprise customers show 2-5% failed transactions during the window.
Carlos: need SLA eligibility triage. @BillingBot can you list the steps and cutoffs we use for credit eligibility?
BillingBot: checklist: 1) Confirm 1h+ continuous partial outage or >2% error rate impacting requests for an SLA tenant OR a reduction in sustained throughput below committed baseline. 2) Confirm affected billing period and invoice IDs. 3) Compute dollar equivalent per contract (monthly commit * downtime fraction). 4) Draft credit note and require PM approval.
Jamie: ok, we'll run through the checklist. Priya — can you capture exact start/end and per-customer fail counts, plus any retries/backoff that masked errors?
Priya: copying paste from query results:
```
affected_window: 2024-07-12T10:12:00Z - 2024-07-12T10:35:00Z
total_requests_usw2: 1,284,321
total_5xx: 34,512 (2.69%)
top_customers: cust-alpha (5.1%), cust-beta (3.3%), cust-gamma (2.2%)
```
Alex: mitigation: scaled up the rtx-pool by +4 nodes at 10:18, rolling restart of gateway instances with new timeout config pushed at 10:21, error rate trending down to 0.4% by 10:30.
IncidentBot: incident status: mitigation in progress -> recovering. no action required for auto-rollback.
Carlos: flags: cust-alpha is on a reserved capacity plan with SLA. cust-beta is on hosted usage with >$50k/mo commit. both might be eligible. cust-gamma on pay-as-you-go so no credit.
BillingBot: Carlos — to compute estimate we need committed baseline for cust-alpha and cust-beta. Please attach contract IDs.
Carlos: attaching contract refs in thread (privately sent to billing).
Jamie: draft status page line for ops-team to post? Suggest:
"status: degraded — inference gateway (us-west-2) — partial 5xx errors affecting a subset of customers. Mitigation applied at 10:18 UTC; full recovery observed by 10:30 UTC. Root cause under investigation — updates at 11:00 UTC."
Alex: looks fine. Add 'no data loss' note.
Jamie: updated draft:
"status: degraded — inference gateway (us-west-2) — partial 5xx errors affecting a subset of customers. Mitigation applied at 10:18 UTC; full recovery observed by 10:30 UTC. No data loss. Root cause under investigation — we will provide a post-incident report."
Priya: preparing internal impact table for SOC and support: will include per-tenant failed_request_count, percent-of-traffic impacted, and first/last failure timestamps.
Carlos: for customer comms, propose a short proactive email for affected tenants with credit eligibility steps included. Draft: 
"Hi — we observed partial errors for a subset of requests to Redwood Inference (us-west-2) on 2024-07-12 between 10:12–10:30 UTC. We mitigated the issue and traffic has stabilized. We're assessing any eligible service credits and will follow up with a personalized reconciliation within 5 business days. If you saw significant impact we can fast-track a more detailed report."
Jamie: 👍 add a link to the status page and an incident tracking ID.
Alex: handoff to oncoming oncall at 10:45. Key notes: mitigation scaled and restarted gateways, rollback not required, root cause suspected GC pressure + kernel network queueing on rtx-pool nodes. collecting kernel logs and GC traces for postmortem.
IncidentBot: oncall_handoff at 1718255500: from Alex -> Jamie.
Jamie: I have the handoff. Next actions: 1) confirm contracts with billing, 2) finalize customer email templates, 3) set follow-up RCA meeting. I'll own customer comms.
BillingBot: once you confirm affected invoice windows and contract IDs, we'll compute provisional credit amounts and produce credit memos for PM sign-off. Expect initial numbers within 24 hours.
Carlos: note for reimbursement policy: small transient spikes that resolve in <20m usually are not eligible unless they cross error-rate thresholds per contract. We're in a gray area for cust-beta — compute both conservative and generous credit figures.
Priya: uploaded logs & query snapshots to /incidents/1718254321/artifacts (internal link).
Jamie: drafting final canned response for support team to send if customers reach out:
"Thanks for flagging this. We experienced partial errors in us-west-2 on 2024-07-12 (10:12–10:30 UTC). We applied mitigation and traffic has recovered. We're evaluating any eligible service credits and will follow up. If you'd like a tailored impact report, reply and we'll prioritize it."
Alex: closing pager; monitoring for 1h. If error-rate stays <0.5% we'll mark incident as resolved and start RCA.
IncidentBot: incident resolved -> monitoring (closed) at 10:35 UTC.
Jamie: filing incident postmortem template and adding SLA credit check as a section. tagging @Carlos and @BillingBot for follow-up.
Carlos: noted. I will coordinate billing outreach and attach the credit memos to the customer communications.
BillingBot: ack. I'll queue the calculations and ping when ready.
Jamie: thanks all — great coordination. :thumbsup:
